name: SupportMessage
description: Server-only bounded support message and administrator email reply record

conversation_token.description: Opaque local token linking this message to a support conversation

access_request_id.description: Protected access request id when this message belongs to an access-request thread

owner_user_id.description: Authenticated platform user id when available

owner_email.description: Normalized authenticated account email when available

role.description: Message role: user, assistant, system, or admin

message_text.description: Bounded visible support message text only

source.description: Message source metadata such as visitor, assistant, handoff, or administrator_email

recipient_email.description: Server-resolved recipient for an administrator email reply

subject.description: Plain-text subject for an administrator email reply

delivery_status.description: Safe transactional email delivery state for an administrator reply

sent_at.description: Server timestamp when the message was stored
